title: Barbecue Pork Ribs
description: Barbecue Pork Ribs is a dish from United States prepared with pork ribs, barbecue sauce, apple cider vinegar. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Oven-and-grill ribs, not fully pit-smoked barbecue.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 80 minutes.
Bake the rubbed ribs tightly covered at 150–160°C until the meat is tender, about 2.5–3 hours; finish with barbecue glaze on the grill.
Grill over medium-high heat for about 18 minutes, turning regularly until charred outside and safely cooked inside.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
